correctness.rationale: For all r,mu>0 and nonnegative starting states at theta=1/2, direct transformation z=x+y-1,d=x-y gives z’=-z(3d²+z²-1)/4 and d’=-d(d²+8u+3z²-1)/4, u=mu/r. Factorization exhausts the 3,5,9 equilibria, with off-divider saddles only for u<1/12, extra divider attracting states precisely below 1/12, and their collision at u=1/8. At u=1/12, the center manifold d²=1/3-3z²+O(z⁴) yields z’=2z³+O(z⁵), excluding convergence from either off-divider half-plane. Invariance, bounded gradient potential, finite equilibria, and sign(z) preservation yield global initial-sum basins for u>=1/12. This proves the critical equality as well as both strict regions; numerical checks alone do not.
